reviews.title: I cannot believe this is a budget airline
reviews.text: What an amazing experience! Great price, easy self check-in Staff are friendly and helpful. Prompt takeoff, comfortable flight. I would absolutely use this airline again!
reviews.author: TessaL63

reviews.title: Great value
reviews.text: It was my first flight with Skymark for a last minute booking, and a very pleasant surprise, especially with the never ending issues Boeing 737 seem to be facing. The seats on this 737-800 were comfortable Recaros, We took off a few minutes late but were out of the plane 15 minutes early. Friendly service. I will fly Skymark again, assuming my return flight is similar.
reviews.author: Vincent D

reviews.title: Excellent low cost but not lcc airline
reviews.text: Perfect service, especially for traveller with road bike. Polite, fast ,trouble free and the custom kitkat and coffee is super nice bonus. Switching from ANA for these guys I do wish they had on board wifi, even at cost
reviews.author: alexred

reviews.title: One of the best airlines for transportation between major cities
reviews.text: 主に大都市・各地域の主要都市を結ぶ航空会社として、高い人気を誇ります。輸送の頻度や量が多い路線に絞っているからこそ、搭乗直前でもANAやJALよりも比較的安価でチケットを購入できます。便数や機内サービスも大手航空会社とほとんど遜色なく、LCCに見られるような追加料金を要するオプションも少なく、少なくとも都市間移動の交通手段として利用する上では最適な航空会社と言えます。 個人的な感覚ではありますが、海外からの観光客の利用が最も少ない路線という印象があります。大手のANAやJAL、もしくは移動手段にお金をかけたくないためにLCCを使う、という二極化があるのか、あるいは航空連合に加入しておらずポイントの還元が出来ないからかもしれません。勿論、海外の観光客が使いにくいと思えるようなサービスの質は見当たりませんでした。 注意したいのが、事前予約した際に発行されたQRコードが自動チェックイン用ではないことです。必ず保安検査前のカウンターで正式なチケットを発行してもらい、そのチケットを利用してチェックインする必要があります。キャビンアテンダントの接客対応については、臨機応変さは大手航空会社と比較するとやや劣っている、という印象です（それだけしっかりと教育・訓練されているという証左かもしれませんが）。 座席の広さ・前後のゆとりはほぼ全席同じで、上位クラスの席は非常に少ないか皆無です。機材によっては座席に充電用コンセントは配置されています。 This airline are highly popular mainly because it connect to major cities and regions. Since it focuses on major city airports rather than regional airports, you can buy boarding tickets at a lower price than with ANA or JAL. This is true even just before the boarding date and time. Not only do they have as many flights as the major airlines, but they also charge less in additional fees due to options like the LCCs. As far as inter-city transportation goes, it's a very just airline. My personal feeling is that there aren't many international users. I think it's either a polarization of users to use the major airlines or LCCs, or it's a lack of membership in the airline coalition that prevents them from redeeming their points. Of course, I didn't find the quality of service to be difficult for foreign tourists to use. The most important thing to note is that the QR code issued to you when you pre-booked is NOT for automatic check-in. Skymark always requires you to ask for a ticket at the counter. The cabin attendants seemed to be a little less flexible in their approach to customer service. Of course, that's not a bad thing at all. Seat size and spacing between the front and back of the seats are nearly identical in all cabins, with very few or no seats in the upper classes. Depending on the aircraft, charging outlets are located in the seats.
reviews.author: Hiroaki Kaneko

reviews.title: NO SOCIAL DISTANCES
reviews.text: Book a ticket by phone to fly on august 4th , and They told me there is a social distances that I wouldn't be able to Sit with my Family on 3 sitting role , so I was given a sit behind my Family , wife and kid, To my surprise The seat they gave me has No social distances with additional 2 people sitting with Me , Soo lying, going on in This pandemic time , is the reasons Japan covid-19 is Increasing everyday , No rules is been abide by This Air line
reviews.author: Emmanuel D

reviews.title: Got deducted money and still got no ticket a day before the flight
reviews.text: On Wednesday, I reserved a ticket for Sunday, I went on their page to pay my ticket. Tried with my international credit card, it was written that the payment was successful and the next page showed an error saying I have to start the procedure again, it didn't work. Thinking it might be an error connected to my international card, I tried with a Japanese debit card, but same result as the first one. I got an email right after I paid that the money got deducted from the bank. Waiting the night for them to send me the flight ticket, got nothing. Next day my Japanese boyfriend call them, they say it never happened before, they will send me the ticket tomorrow. The next day, still nothing, call them again, they say they will send it tomorrow. Here I am on Saturday at 11pm, with no ticket yet, my flight is tomorrow 10am.
reviews.author: Marion

reviews.title: Low cost but Nice concept of the international flight
reviews.text: Skymark just started the fight between Tokyo - Saipan. It took 10 hours from Japan to Saipan via Korea before, but now 3 hours ! A reasonable flight began at last. They can not serve a hot meal, because of utilizing a domestic material. However, many choices of drinks, and the Japanese dishes ( Sushi, etc ) on the going way , and local cooking of Saipan and salada on the way back. The meal service is enough for a 3-4 hours flight, I enjoyed much. The ground staff at Saipan are also very kind. Hope they will have flight in other routes with the same concept - good service and reasonable fare.
reviews.author: Salty Traveller

reviews.title: Good Experience from the start
reviews.text: It was good experience from the start of booking and checkin at the airport was a breeze as well as the whole journey. No complaints.
reviews.author: shahrul79

reviews.title: Excellent service from Japanese low cost airline.
reviews.text: Used this airline for return trip from Sapporo to get to Toyota for the rugby. It was clean, efficient, and on time; cabin crew were charming and we were served with a drink and small snack, which was unexpected on a relatively short internal flight. Flight was easily booked on line, and self-check-in was quick and efficient.
reviews.author: taffandhubby

reviews.title: simple, no frills but cost/time effective airline
reviews.text: I had an opportunity to take their flight due to very tight schedule and happened to be the optimal selection to fly back to Tokyo. The flight itself is very simple but fulfilling the basic service as an airline company. Therefore I would recommend under certain circumstances to take sky mark for your choice of flight.
reviews.author: TokyoTrotter

reviews.title: Decent check in luggage space
reviews.text: Each passenger allowed 20kg and any number of bags. We had to pay 10kg excess and it cost only 1000yen. Reasonable. Tickets are relatively inexpensive too (about 25000yen for 2passengers).
reviews.author: small.world

reviews.title: Budget flight easy
reviews.text: Picked up the flight for 135 aus dollars. Self check in easy and overall good service. They serve a kit kat snack and a coffee. Thumbs up
reviews.author: Russell A

reviews.title: Book early and save on flights
reviews.text: Booking your flights aboard Skymark Airlines can save you money. Have been flying Skymark for the past few years and it is more cost effective than taking the train or ferry from Kobe to Kyushu if you are going to Nagasaki. Book early and mid-week to save the most.
reviews.author: captainked

reviews.title: Highwater mark in customer service
reviews.text: This was the first time I had flown on a Japanese airline. I suspected that Japan's world leading customer service might find its way onto its airlines and I was not disappointed with Skymark. Everything about the experience was outstanding. Check-in and luggage check was super smooth and professional. Boarding was only 15 minutes prior to departure and conducted extremely efficiently with window, middle and aisle seats boarding in that order. The aircraft was spotless with each seat being a stylish light beige leather. Cabin crew were outstanding. Nothing was too difficult. In flight service consisted of tea, coffee, water and a kit-kat! Drinks and small snacks were available for purchase. This is where the airline really stood out - prices were extremely reasonable. Unlike most airlines that gouge their customers, Skymark were only charging 300 Yen for beer and 100 Yen for soft drinks. I highly recommend this airline and look forward to using again in the future.
reviews.author: Matthew Scott

reviews.title: Great Value
reviews.text: The fares are quite low compared to the Shinkansen and include check-in baggage. Seat selection is also included in the airfare. Staff was friendly and efficient at both check-in and boarding. Seat width and legroom were acceptable (RECARO BL3710 seats). Food and drinks on board are priced quite cheaply. Free Kit Kat on board too.
reviews.author: Not-a-bot123

reviews.title: Great value and service despite being a budget airline
reviews.text: Exceptional ground staff at the check in at Kobe airport which went out of their way to help check in.
reviews.author: tony12cu

reviews.title: Very impressive
reviews.text: Disclosure: I almost always fly business class and am a bit of a snob about air travel, but I decided that for this short-haul flight I would give relatively low-cost Skymark a try. I was very happy with my choice. Everything from booking to seat selection to screening to boarding and inflight service worked very smoothly. The staff were extremely attentive and happy. The plane was a comfortable Boeing, such a nice change from the wretched regional jets prevalent on similar short-hop routes in the US and elsewhere. I was impressed by the calmly rational boarding process - first window seats, then middle seats, finally aisles - that worked efficiently. While in-flight service was expectedly limited, I was really blown away that one flight attendant stood at the head of the aisle for the entire two hour flight, entirely focused on scanning passengers to see if she could render assistance. Even on first class flights I’ve never seen such devotion to service. It’s a pity that much of Skymark’s business model could never be made to work outside Japan, reliant as it is on social norms in that country: in the US, staff would quit during the first day of training when they were told that they actually had to be nice to the customers.
reviews.author: John R

reviews.title: Good service with cheap price
reviews.text: I really love skymark as it has a good service with less price and they also allow 20 kg of Cabin luggage. The flight was in time and the staffs are very friendly.
reviews.author: Shahnewaj Bin Mannan

reviews.title: Convenient Hokkaido Flight
reviews.text: Shopping carefully allows flying Skymark to Haneda rather than one of the LCC fares plus baggage charges to Narita. My latest flight was comfortable and on time.
reviews.author: jimtokyo

reviews.title: This is the airline between LCC and FSC
reviews.text: From my feeling, it is NOT a LCC nor FSC (Full Service Carrier), it is between them. The airfare is NOT so cheap, and the services are OK ( but you have to buy ). At HANEDA, they use bus from terminal to planes, instead of using boarding bridge. It is sometimes troublesome if it is rain. At Nagasaki airport , they use same boarding bridge as FSC uses. The problem is that they stop at KOBE on the way of the flight since KOBE is their HUB airport. Overall it is OK because regular airfare is cheaper than FSC regular airfare, but comparing FSC's discount airfare, they are similar price.
reviews.author: 克也 西

reviews.title: On time
reviews.text: As the days get very busy, there is always need to fly back and forth between Tokyo and Kobe. Therefore I greatly value ease with check in, waiting time/ lounge, boarding and seat comfort. Skymark has continuously offered this and the same was the case last week not to mention the refreshment I received on board even when it was an hour flight.
reviews.author: Vialey L

reviews.title: good flights,comfortable seats
reviews.text: compared to domestic australian airlines this one has big seats and comfortable. The staff were very attentive they are on time and you get 20kg free baggage. what's not to love when cruising between cities? Will always use when doing the quick hop inside Japan. Very good prices.
reviews.author: samantha d

reviews.title: Quick and Affordable Flight between Kyushu and Tokyo
reviews.text: After many hours on the road and on trains, decided to take a quick flight from Fukuoka to Tokyo to catch my next appointment. The check-in was quick and there were no delays as can sometimes be the case with these small carriers.
reviews.author: Vialey L

reviews.title: Good experience
reviews.text: The flight was on time and the luggage arrived as well. All in all good experience and nothing major to complain about.
reviews.author: Pinga123

reviews.title: Was fine, nothing special, but o.k
reviews.text: Was fine, nothing special, but o.k For the price, it is fine, so will probably use them again. They have the earliest flight to Sapporo
reviews.author: Shlomi T

reviews.title: Great service at low price
reviews.text: Living in Kobe, Japan, I always use Skymark to fly to Tokyo and Nagasaki. Skymark is the best domestic airline I’ve ever used in Japan. They offer as good services as big airline companies such as JAL or ANA at reasonable prices as low as LCC airlines. Check-in luggages are not charged up to 20kg. The quality of in-line services are very good as well. Once, when a typhoon was approaching and the plane was in a strong turbulence, both the captain and the cabin attendant settled the passengers’ worries by making excellent explanations about the conditions minute by minute. I want to fly to Okinawa, Kagoshima, Sendai, etc. as well on Skymark.
reviews.author: Miki S

reviews.title: Great value!
reviews.text: My 2nd trip with Skymark. Everything's goood. Tickets cheap, Check in was fast using the self service kiosk to get our boarding passes and luggage tags, plane was in good condition, flight was on schedule and service was great. Simple drinks and even wine can be bought on board and prices were cheap. Highly recommended!
reviews.author: DavidLee1234

reviews.title: Efficient and Proffesional
reviews.text: I was delayed on an Air Canada flight and missed my prior flight without notification. (It had been booked through a third party) Skymark was extremely helpful in re-booking me at no extra charge on the first flight available. I am impressed at the service given by a discount airline. 👍🏻
reviews.author: John F

reviews.title: Great flight from Kobe to Tokyo
reviews.text: Quick, easy, inexpensive flight. Can't beat it. Only negative was they changed the gate, but never made an announcement in English. Luckily I found someone that worked there that spoke English and could tell me what was going on.
reviews.author: Teaforthree

reviews.title: Simple and convenient
reviews.text: seat by the window or get a 1000 yen upgrade for more leg room. The flight was really smooth, the staff is super friendly. Checking terminals are easy to use. Excellent choice for domestic flights within Japan.
reviews.author: Marco M

reviews.title: okay for the price
reviews.text: don't expect too much from Skymark airlines as they are economical airline, but left NGO and got to OKA on time. Since it's the earliest flight out of NGO, gave me plenty of time to do things once I got there, so it's very convenient for me. but one thing, would be nice if the ground staff are a bit more friendly, I don't need them to be perky or miss sunshine at first thing in the morning but doesn't hurt to smile a little more when we were being polite.
reviews.author: Agent0069JP

reviews.title: Excellent airlines ...
reviews.text: Excellent airlines, price, and customer services all the way. The check in process is fast no hassle. They provide free check in luggage for 20 kg and free drink. You can bring on board one carry on and one personal item with total weight 10 kg. Definitely will fly with Skymark Airlines again. What a great experience.
reviews.author: Hanny Tjiptadi

reviews.title: Surprisingly good
reviews.text: I booked a last minute flight for a spur of the moment trip through Skymark- It was the first time booking through this company and I found them due to the best price on Skyscanner. However, not even 24 hrs after booking the already last minute flight without insurance there was a crisis situation. Surprisingly Skymark allowed me to go online and cancel the trip for a $70 cancellation fee. I was really impressed with the ease of navigation- yes canceling a flight is listed on the homepage! And Skymark was a ray of sunshine on an otherwise bleak day. I will definitely book with Skymark again in the future and recommend to friends.
reviews.author: Jess08Tyler

reviews.title: Good value.
reviews.text: For the price we paid, it was really good value deal. It's basically a budget airline with a 20kg (i think) free baggage allowance. Check in was simple. Just line up at the self check in kiosk, next continue down the line for baggage scanning and check in your bags. Flight was uneventful. You can buy drinks at an ok price. Although we were delayed about 2hrs by bad weather. This is no fault of the airline.
reviews.author: DavidLee1234

reviews.title: Exceptional regional flights
reviews.text: We booked our flights for this service online via another website, ended up paying online and finishing the reservation using google chrome and the translate function it can get quite difficult to understand and navigate but once done you receive a QR code which you use at the airport to check in. Once at the check in counter everyone is so friendly and helpful. The flight it self was very good and basically what you would expect from a budget airline. Would definitely fly with them domestically in Japan again.
reviews.author: aaren17

reviews.title: A top budget airline
reviews.text: I booked this flight directly from Melbourne, Australia using Skymark website. Easy to follow steps and was able to select 3 seats months before the flight at no charge. Aircraft was a Boeing 737_800 quite new and spotless.. Check in and boarding was easy. No meals were offered but it was a short flight under 2 hours. Snacks and refreshments were available for purchase at reasonable price. Cash only and in Yen. Would definitely fly Skymark again.
reviews.author: Thomas H

reviews.title: Cost performance is better than other airplane between Kobe and Haneda
reviews.text: It is better way between Kobe and Haneda. It has high cost performance. This flight is cheaper than Shinkansen express under the special case. I almost use this flight. I can save time on the something to ride and I don't get much tired.
reviews.author: すぽっく

reviews.title: Great first time flight with Skymark
reviews.text: I booked this flight directly from Melbourne, Australia using Skymark website. Easy to follow steps and was able to select 3 seats months before the flight at no charge. Aircraft was a Boeing 737_800 quite new and spotless.. Check in and boarding was easy. No meals were offered but it was a short flight under 2 hours. Snacks and refreshments were available for purchase at reasonable price. Cash only and in Yen. Would definitely fly Skymark again.
reviews.author: Thomas H

reviews.title: Decent budget airline
reviews.text: Skymark offers a decent quality budget airline service in Japan. The flight was uneventful, but the service had a air of high quality, quite common in Japan. You can get decent prices if you forego the chance to edit your flight times and such. Had to call their helpline to fix a typo in the order, they were very friendly, but helpline service was only offered in Japanese.
reviews.author: Heikki S

reviews.title: Good value
reviews.text: Very easy. Digital check in, no hassles. Super-friendly staff. Paid drink service only, no movies, TV's, or monitors to distract the kids with, plus announcements were made in Japanese language only (I can understand and my wife is Japanese so no problems for us) so if you think you will need assistance in another language, think twice. The flights were smooth and there were no delays, so there were no unnecessary and bothersome announcements from the cockpit. I am a 6' heavy-set American, and this flight was very comfortable with plenty of legroom and comfort. I slept very well, which I usually don't do! I will definitely use this airline again for domestic flights and would recommend this airline to my friends for domestic flights. For international flights though, Osaka Kansai Airport is a really easy international transfer hub so consider that when planning your next trip.
reviews.author: Beach Bum

reviews.title: Waw!
reviews.text: I think it has to be the best low cost airline, if not simply the best airline in the world! I flew with them only once so I may have go lucky, flying between Tokyo and Sapporo, but the place had features I never seen before. First, ALL the seats were Business type, meaning large with huge room for your legs, like a business seat of ANA (used them once for the same Tokyo - Sapporo). That was already pretty cool itself but then you fast realized the place had full free WIFI, wth! And this for about USD 150 go and back! Once again it seemed to good to be true so I don't know if you can expect the same on every of their planes but this was for me the best airline experience ever!
reviews.author: Francois-Xavier S
